shortDefinition.en: The light delivered to a recording area over the exposure duration; displayed brightness also depends on output processing.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 曝光持续时间内传递到记录区域的光；显示亮度还取决于输出处理。

en: Exposure and final JPEG brightness are related but not interchangeable.
zh-cn: 曝光与最终 JPEG 亮度相关，但不能混为一谈。

example.en: Aperture and shutter duration shape exposure before ISO-related output mapping is applied.
example.zh-cn: 光圈与快门时间先塑造曝光，之后才是 ISO 相关输出映射。

sources.title: Camera Exposure — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: The physical contributions of aperture and exposure duration.
